who: Real stack · local stand-ins for SMS
title: Every reservation, from every channel, in one book
sub: An AI phone agent, a booking page, SMS and the staff panel share one engine: table joins, no double bookings, reminders and a waitlist.
outro: Python · FastAPI · SQLite · Twilio-style SMS · voice-agent tool webhooks · Docker · e2e in GitHub Actions.
thumbSub: Table Desk · phone agent + SMS + panel

caps.text: A guest books on the restaurant's page
Only times with a free table are offered. The booking is checked again when it's saved
Booked, with a code and a link to cancel
The confirmation text arrives on the guest's phone
Meanwhile the AI phone agent takes a call for 8 people: it checks, books and confirms
Two tables joined for the party of 8. The platform's retry didn't book twice
8 p.m. is full now. The phone agent puts the next caller on the waitlist
A guest texts STORNO. The table is free, and Ada gets an offer by text
Ada answers JA, and the table is hers
The staff see the whole day: who booked how, cancellations and the waitlist booking
Every text in and out, and anything that needs a person
